1. Charging by the hour Hourly rates punish you for being fast. Price the outcome, not the time: start with day rates or fixed project packages.

3. No contract, no deposit A one-page agreement and a 30–50% deposit filter out the clients who were never going to pay.
4. Skipping the follow-up Most proposals die in silence, not in a "no". Follow up three times, 3–4 days apart. Polite persistence wins.
